entities.name: Cândido de Figueiredo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: António Pereira Cândido de Figueiredo, usually referred to as Cândido de Figueiredo was a Portuguese lawyer and civil servant by trade who later became well-known as a writer, lexicographer, grammarian, and philologist specializing in the Portuguese language.
